notes: Declarative game sources. fetch-games.mjs clones/copies these into bundled-games/ with generated manifests. Only permissively-licensed (or GPL-with-attribution) sources are bundled. Everything else becomes a catalog 'external' entry.

sources.author: bridge-mind
sources.description: Open-source Minecraft-style voxel game in a single HTML file. Procedural worlds, survival, crafting, mobs. Needs internet for Three.js CDN on first load.

sources.author: StarKnightt
sources.description: Complete first-person shooter in a single HTML file. No build step; loads Three.js from a CDN (needs internet).

sources.author: duysqubix
sources.description: Procedurally-generated 3D dungeon maze. First-person horror — something else is in there with you. WASD + mouse. Loads Three.js from a CDN (needs internet).

sources.author: 99fk
sources.description: Single-file Reversi with AI, undo, hints and sound. GPL-3.0 — license included.

sources.author: 99fk
sources.description: Minimalist Backgammon in a single file. Play against a friend or the built-in AI. GPL-3.0 — license included.

sources.author: Kuber Mehta
sources.description: A self-contained game that fits inside a QR code, inspired by DOOM 1993 and The Backrooms. Bundled without the optional 5 MB music file (fully playable offline).
